purpose: Rebuild the three additional licensed captures; raw videos stay outside the repository.
steps: Download only the exact source.json entries after reviewing their licenses. Verify SHA256.
Extract numbered %04d.png files to {root}/{id}-frames with ffmpeg -ss START -i RAW -t SECONDS -vf FILTER; retain native fps.

python scripts/build-captured-walker.py --id ID --source SOURCE --frames ROOT/ID-frames --masks ROOT/ID-focused-masks --poses ROOT/ID-refined-poses.json --out public/walkers --qa-dir ROOT --fps FPS --segment-start START --minimum-period MIN --maximum-period MAX --unconstrained-mask --optical-support --seam-blend N
Review every alpha frame, update cast.json stride from the generated calibration, then node --test tests/walker-atlas.test.mjs and npm run build.
Run isolated production preview; python scripts/verify-walker-browser.py --out artifacts/crowd-six; python scripts/render-six-comparison.py creates the phone video.
limits: Crop windows and pose data belong to these exact source resolutions only. A new source requires manual review. Four-frame alpha loop closure is an authored correction, not additional captured footage. Numerical synchronization does not guarantee zero visible toe/heel slide.
